service: Issuance of Certified True Copy of Birth Certificate
description: Issuance of certified transcriptions and true copies of Certificate of Live Birth registered with the Local Civil Registry Office (LCRO) of Roxas City.
steps: Fill out request slip at the LCRO Public Assistance Counter, 1F Roxas City Hall.
Verify entry in the civil registry database or historical registry books.
Pay certification fee at the City Treasury cashier.
Present official receipt and claim certified document.
requirements: Valid Government-issued ID of document owner or requesting authorized party
Authorization Letter and ID of owner if applicant is a representative
Exact details: Full Name of child, Date of Birth, Place of Birth, Father's Name, Mother's Maiden Name

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Document owner, parent, legal guardian, or authorized representative

description: Filing of application for marriage license for contracting parties where at least one party is a resident of Roxas City.
steps: Both applicants submit required documents at LCRO Roxas City.
Undergo Pre-Marriage Counseling (PMC) with City Health and CSWDO.
Claim Marriage License at LCRO (valid for 120 days nationwide).
requirements: PSA Birth Certificate of both parties
Barangay Certificate of Residency from Roxas City
Valid Government IDs of both parties
Parental Consent (for ages 18-21) or Parental Advice (for ages 22-24)

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Couples planning marriage where at least one party is a Roxas City resident
